app.name: cc-switch-web
app.one_liner: A cross-platform web-based All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode & OMO with cloud/headless deployment support.

screens.name: Provider & MCP Dashboard
screens.purpose: Display and manage AI providers, MCP servers, and active configurations for multiple AI toolchains.

screens.name: Skills Marketplace
screens.purpose: Browse and install Claude skills from GitHub repositories.

screens.name: Web Server Settings
screens.purpose: Configure headless Web Server mode including authentication and network settings.

rust_commands.name: backup_config
rust_commands.purpose: Serialize and save current application configuration with version history.

rust_commands.name: install_skill
rust_commands.purpose: Download and install a Claude skill from a GitHub URL into the correct local path.

rust_commands.name: switch_provider
rust_commands.purpose: Switch the active API provider endpoint for a given AI toolchain (e.g., Claude, Codex).

mvp_plan: week 1: Add config backup/restore with versioning
week 1: Build main dashboard UI with provider/MCP listing
week 1: Implement core provider switching logic with env preservation
week 2: Add system prompt editor with syntax highlighting
week 2: Implement Web Server mode with Basic Auth
week 2: Integrate GitHub-based skills installer with path validation
acceptance_tests: MCP servers for Claude/Codex/Gemini display correctly; OpenCode MCP/plugins render without UI anomalies.
Skills installed from GitHub appear in the marketplace and are placed in the correct filesystem path.
User can change Web Server password after initial setup.
User can switch between OpenAI-compatible providers without losing nested env variables in configuration.
Web Server mode starts on Linux x86_64 and serves UI with Basic Auth protection.
